What we deliver

Sub-services tailored to your stage

Each internal tools engagement is shaped by the problem in front of us — these are the lanes we typically work in.

Admin Dashboards

Powerful dashboards to manage your business

A real command center for your team — not a static report. We build internal dashboards that pull live data from your stack, surface exceptions, and let your operators take action without leaving the page.

  • Live data from your DB, warehouse, or SaaS APIs
  • Role-based views for ops, finance, and leadership
  • Drill-down, filters, and saved views
  • Slack and email alerts on the metrics that matter

CRM Systems

Customer relationship management tailored to you

When Salesforce or HubSpot is overkill, we build a CRM that matches your sales motion. Pipeline stages, follow-ups, contracts, and customer health — exactly what your team needs, and nothing they do not.

  • Pipeline, deal stages, and forecasting
  • Email, call, and meeting integrations
  • Customer health and renewal workflows
  • Custom fields and objects without a sales call

Inventory Management

Track stock, orders, and logistics efficiently

Inventory is one mistake away from a stockout or a write-off. We build inventory systems that track SKUs across locations, integrate with your POS and marketplace channels, and surface the reorder decisions before they become a problem.

  • Multi-location stock and transfers
  • POS, Shopify, and marketplace sync
  • Lot, serial, and expiry tracking
  • Purchase orders and supplier workflows

Workflow Automation

Automate repetitive tasks and save time

We turn the manual steps that eat your week into reliable automations. Lead routing, invoice generation, customer onboarding sequences, and the glue between tools that does not have a Zapier template.

  • Visual workflow designer with version history
  • Retry, idempotency, and error handling
  • Audit log of every action and decision
  • Connectors for 200+ SaaS tools out of the box

FAQ

Questions we hear most often

  • How is this different from off-the-shelf SaaS?
    Off-the-shelf SaaS optimizes for the average customer. A custom internal tool optimizes for your exact workflow — and you stop paying per seat as you grow. We recommend SaaS when it is the right answer, and a custom build when it is not.
  • How long until my team can use it?
    Our target is a usable first build in one to two weeks, with a feature-complete v1 in 6–10 weeks depending on integrations. We ship in weekly increments and demo every Friday.
  • Will my team be able to maintain it?
    Yes. We pick boring, well-documented stacks, write the README your future team will read, and run a handover sprint where we pair with whoever owns the tool day-to-day.
  • What if the requirements change mid-build?
    Expected. Our process is built around short feedback loops — weekly demos, shared roadmap, and a feature flag system that lets you turn changes on and off without redeploying.
